review_kind: Direct actual-native-frame appearance review, separate from numerical and source/unit acceptance.
method: Each actual full native BMP viewed at original resolution, baseline then candidate, in power/tick order. No scaled montage or synthetic image substituted for runtime frames.
summary: Visual review passes for all 18 native-2x baseline/candidate pairs at P1, P6 and P11. The three shadows retain distinct small-round, large-offset-round and oblique silhouettes with dark interiors and cleaner edges. Visible cloud/terrain contrast and head appearance remain consistent, with no visible halo, misplaced shadow or detached residue. This is limited to the retained SDL-dummy/original-v1-FIRE frames; partially clipped or covered contours, unobserved overlaps, 4x, Windows and manual gameplay are not validated. Exact numerical checks are reported separately.

findings.225: Small round silhouette, retained size and original visible head-to-shadow placement; clean dark edges in P1/P6.
findings.244: Large offset round silhouette with a broad dark interior; cleaner boundary in P6/P11.
findings.226: Distinct short oblique form in P11, clearest against the left cloud region at ticks 42–45.
findings.head_appearance: No visible cyan-white head-color regression. This does not imply numerical equality of translucent head pixels on a changed underlay.
findings.background_appearance: Visible cloud and rocky-terrain shadows retain different contrast; these are appearance observations, not trace-proven material provenance.
findings.artifacts: No new visible halo, displaced silhouette, detached residue or rectangular patch in the reviewed portions.

limitations: Exactly 18 paired native 2x stills at P1/P6/P11, ticks 40–45. No video or unseen-frame coverage.
Diagnostic Linux SDL dummy/software captures use the original stationary continuous-FIRE input. No native 4x, Windows, physical-display/GPU, manual-play or broader gameplay acceptance.
Clipping, foreground/head/shadow coverage and low-contrast terrain hide portions of contours. Full silhouettes and unobserved overlap variants are not visually certified.
Actual opaque-head-erasure observations are zero. Fractional-head dependencies and support/shared-core/state equality are separately attributed to RUNTIME.json.
Visible cloud/terrain contrast and no observed residue do not establish material provenance, exact same-pixel scene ordering or exact blend arithmetic.
Original game pixels/data, captures and private paths are excluded; this summary contains findings and hash identities only.
